records.subject: Central Office Annex, 1617 Lauder Rd
records.body:
Hi City Waste team,

TCEQ's Central Registry lists a construction stormwater authorization (TXR154490) dated September 24 for Central Office Annex at 1617 Lauder Rd, Houston in Harris County. The operator on file is Nupi Americas Inc. It's about 7 miles from your Houston yard, and an industrial site like this is the kind of job your roll-off containers serve; that's our read, not the filing.

We're a research service with no connection to the project: each week we pull new construction sites from state records and match them to haulers by service area. The sample costs nothing; after it, our 30-day pilot is a one-time $500 for 15–20 verified projects, with no subscription.
